extension.summary: Scrobble plays to your Scrob instance
extension.description: Automatically tracks movies and TV shows in your self-hosted Scrob instance as you watch them in Kodi.
extension.news:
1.2.3 - Fix: the Status line now renders correctly in settings (switched from invalid label control to disabled edit control) - Fix: the API Key field was missing from the settings entirely (Kodi drops an empty text setting that isn't marked as allowing an empty value)
1.2.2 - Fix: all settings are now shown at the Basic settings level (Scrob URL, API Key and Sync options were hidden below Standard) - Fix: the Status line now renders on all Kodi versions
1.2.1 - Connection settings now show a Status line: authorized, using an API key, or not connected
1.2.0 - Authorize with Scrob using a device code (open your-scrob-url/link and approve) instead of an API key; the API key still works as a fallback - Mark a title watched once playback passes a configurable % of the runtime (default 90%), instead of only when it plays to the very end - Scrobble titles marked watched from the Kodi menu (or auto-marked by Kodi) - Sync ratings from Scrob back into the Kodi library (userrating) - Optionally re-sync from Scrob on an interval so several Kodi boxes converge
1.1.3 - Fix episodes and movies not marked as watched after resume-from-stop
1.1.2 - Fix scrobbling not working for TV episodes (switch to JSON-RPC Player.GetItem)
1.1.1 - Fix scrobbling not working for TV episodes (retry reading metadata after OnPlay)
1.1.0 - Sync settings: toggle scrobbling to Scrob and library sync from Scrob on startup - Rate movies and/or episodes after watching via a 1-10 star popup (optional, default off)
1.0.0 - Initial release

extension.description: Official Kodi add-on repository for Scrob.
